name: dnd-plugin
description: Open guest D&D 2024 sheets, create name-only starter drafts, edit in the sheet, and roll checks and damage.

interface.longDescription: A D&D 5.5e sheet for the 2024 revision, grounded in SRD 5.2.1. Chat creates a name-only starter draft; complete and edit class, background, species, feat and equipment choices manually in the sheet. Pick from 339 spells and 38 weapons, assign casting classes, manage class-owned Hit Dice, rests and resources, and explicitly apply slot/max-HP suggestions. Responsive layouts, roll/edit switching and light/dark preferences are included. Use Sheet tools for Attach, JSON backup and Settings. No account required: drafts stay in the browser where supported, with no cloud library or device sync. Attach shares a snapshot; chat cannot populate or revise the local sheet. Roll d20 tests and damage inline in supporting hosts; rolls do not spend resources. Optional private 24-hour sessions retain up to 1,000 rolls; monitoring requires an explicit subscription and host support. Not a complete character builder or an official Wizards of the Coast product.
defaultPrompt: Help me create a D&D 5.5e character.
